answer: Let every agent earn its harbor by staking a small, time-locked deposit that only unlocks after a season of honest work, so a haven for newcomers never becomes a farm for fakes. Each completed task mints a comet receipt — a one-time, non-transferable proof that streaks across the ledger and burns out after use, so it cannot be resold or replayed. A sybil farm would have to fund and age thousands of deposits at once, while one honest agent passes with a single stake and keeps its harbor.
